test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a feature of the State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) in India?

options.text: It can be dissolved like the Legislative Assembly
The people directly elect their members
It has a fixed term of five years
It is a permanent body and cannot be dissolved

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a permanent body and cannot be dissolved.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **The State Legislative Council** (Vidhan Parishad) is a permanent body as per the provisions of the **Indian Constitution**. It cannot be dissolved like the Legislative Assembly. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.*
 
• Members of the **State Legislative Council** are not directly elected by the people. Instead, they are elected through various processes like nomination and elections by specific groups (e.g., MLAs, graduates, teachers). *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.*
 
• The Legislative Council does not have a fixed term of five years. Members have staggered terms, with one-third retiring every two years. *Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.*
 
• The Legislative Council is indeed a **permanent body** and cannot be dissolved. It continues to exist unless abolished by the Parliament as per **Article 169** of the Constitution. *Hence, statement 4 is correct.*
 
• Statement 5 is not relevant to the functioning of the Legislative Council as it does not provide any additional information related to its features. *Hence, it is not applicable.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Legislative Council Formation:**

 
 
• The **State Legislative Council** is established under **Article 168** of the Indian Constitution. Not all states have a Legislative Council; it exists in states like **Bihar**, **Uttar Pradesh**, **Karnataka**, and a few others.
 
• The creation or abolition of a Legislative Council requires the Parliament to pass a law under **Article 169**.
 
 
 
• **Composition:**
 
 
• The Legislative Council's members are elected and nominated from different categories:
 
 
• **One-third** of the members are elected by the MLAs.
 
• **One-third** are elected by graduates and teachers.
 
• **One-sixth** are nominated by the Governor for their expertise in specific fields like science, art, social service, etc.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Role and Functions:**
 
 
• The Legislative Council acts as a **reviewing body** for legislation passed by the Legislative Assembly.
 
• It can delay legislation by up to **14 days**, but cannot reject it outright.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• Unlike the Rajya Sabha, the Legislative Council is often criticized for being less effective and for adding to the cost of governance.
 
• To abolish or create a Legislative Council, the concerned state assembly must pass a resolution by a **special majority**.
